# Bink 1.6b

`lib/binkw32.lib` is the import library swkotor2.exe links for binkw32.dll 1.6b (2003-12-10). It is the release
import library of the Bink 1.6b reconstruction (TeamGizka BinkSDK), identical to the shipped SDK library.
`include/` holds the public headers of that SDK (bink.h, rad3d.h, radbase.h); the build compiles against them.
